### Chargement des packages

```{r}
# 1. Installer le package si nécessaire
install.packages("mosaicData")
install.packages("fda")
install.packages("tidyfun")
install.packages("viridis")
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("RColorBrewer")
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(fda)
library(tidyfun)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(mosaicData)
```



### Chargement des données
```{r}
df = read_csv("TaxiTraffic.csv")
```

```{r}
data <- df |>
  select(-`...1`) |>
  separate(col = `timestamp`, into = c("Day", "Hour"), sep = " ") |>
  mutate(
    Hour = if_else(is.na(Hour) | Hour == "", "00:00:00", Hour)
  )
summary(data)
head(data)
```

```{r}
data$Hour_posix <- as.POSIXct(paste("1970-01-01", data$Hour), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

data$Days_factor <- as.factor(data$Day)
colors <- as.numeric(data$Days_factor)
#plot(data$Hour_posix[1:48], data$value[1:48], col=colors[1:48])

# Tracer le plot sans l'axe X par défaut
plot(data$Hour_posix, data$value, col = colors, xaxt = "n", xlab = "Heure", ylab = "Valeur")

# Ajouter un axe X personnalisé avec uniquement les heures (ex: toutes les 3 heures)
axis.POSIXct(1, at = seq(min(data$Hour_posix), max(data$Hour_posix), by = "1 hour"), format = "%H:%M:%S")
```
